regime_context: China A-shares tape is narrow and one-narrative: Coal leads with a weak-durability mean-revert signature, Banks are the only eligible challenger (trending but crowded), and the rotation breadth is just 9%—two elligible of 22 themes. The validated trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (mean-reverting whipsaws), so the entire display is experimental here; my own directional accuracy in this market has been poor, so I lean low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's one-narrative leadership survives its next shake-out: if 515220.SS breaks its 10-day relative high against the CSI 300 while Banks (512800.SS) fails to close the 0.212 rotation margin, the one-narrative regime is intact and I retire the handoff hypothesis; if Banks close that margin and Coal's breadth drops below 0.5, the handoff is confirmed and I retire the Coal-only watch.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only high-durability, eligible, trend-tagged theme besides the leader; they carry full breadth and a strong durability bar relative to Coal's weak mean-revert signature. The rotation margin to Coal is narrow, so this is a handoff-observable rather than a standalone momentum call. Crowding is a size-down caution only.
theses.dissent: Banks are the most crowded theme in the table; if the one-narrative stays glued to Coal, Banks' eligibility is just a ranking artifact and crowded positioning caps any re-rating.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by 3% before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal leads the rank but its signature is mean-revert with weak durability (0.55) and only 60% breadth; the detector's own backtest says the trend gate fails on this mean-reverting A-share tape, so the leader is attention, not a trend to chase. I avoid adding here, not fade.
theses.dissent: Coal could be the real fundamental winner with strong cash flow and a coal-price tailwind; mean-revert tag just reflects a recent shake-out, and avoiding the leader forfeits the only working narrative.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS holds above the CSI 300 by 5% on a 15-day relative basis.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals rank 3 but are not eligible and show zero breadth (no cohesion); in a two-theme eligible tape this is a lagging cyclical with no trend-health. Avoid relative exposure until the trend-gate reopens it.
theses.dissent: Zero breadth with a trend tag can mark early accumulation before a handoff; exclusion could miss the next leg if Coal's leadership cycles into broader cyclicals.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS becomes eligible and its breadth expands above 0.5 before the 20-day check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
